_about: Fictional inbox and sent mail for Riley Bennett (riley.bennett@pellmoor.example). All data is invented.

messages.subject: Summary from today
messages.body:
Erik,

Thanks for the time today. Short summary as promised: Lakeshore protects 14 servers across nine clients, backups are checked by hand each morning, and you are looking at what's available with no active project yet. Your cyber insurance renewal is coming up and you may take another look afterward.

I'll leave it with you. Reach out whenever the timing is right.

Ted

messages.subject: Recap and overview deck
messages.body:
Priya, Tom,

Thanks for yesterday. Attached is the Pellmoor overview deck you can share with your owner. Tom, on your reseeding question: I'll bring our engineer to the next call to walk through how a migration handles existing backup data.

Ted

Thanks. Showed the deck to our owner, he wants to understand what a migration looks like before we go further. I'm buried with year-end client projects, will come back to you.

Priya Raman
Operations Manager, Blue Heron IT
